title: Fixed-tree reduction vs atomic-order reduction reproducibility (CUDA)
info: Real CUDA-C: a fixed-structure tree reduction and a single-threaded order-dependent accumulation over the same 32 values (one huge value plus the integers 1..31), executed on the software SIMT GPU; three different accumulation orders on the identical input measure a real, bounded, nonzero spread (20.0) purely from float non-associativity.
